description: Official U.S. Department of Justice portrait of Sally Q. Yates, former Deputy Attorney General and briefly Acting Attorney General in January 2017. She is shown smiling in a teal blazer with small hoop earrings in front of a U.S. flag against a brown studio backdrop. The manifest filename 'Sally_Q._Yates.jpg' matches her widely published official photo.

Official government portrait of Susan Rice, former U.S. National Security Advisor and U.N. Ambassador under President Obama. She wears a gray tweed blazer and a pearl necklace, photographed before a U.S. flag on a blue backdrop. The 220px filename indicates a Wikipedia thumbnail of her official photo.

Official U.S. Department of Justice portrait of Loretta Lynch, U.S. Attorney General from 2015 to 2017. She is shown in a navy jacket over a white top with a pearl necklace, in front of a U.S. flag on a warm brown backdrop. The filename identifies it as her official portrait (Wikipedia 220px thumbnail).

Official CIA portrait of John Brennan, Director of the Central Intelligence Agency from 2013 to 2017. He wears a dark pinstripe suit with a blue tie, flanked by the U.S. flag with the CIA seal partially visible on the wall behind him. The filename identifies it as his official CIA portrait (Wikipedia 220px thumbnail).

Official FBI portrait of James Comey, Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation from 2013 until his dismissal in May 2017. He is shown smiling in a dark navy suit with a red patterned tie, before a U.S. flag on a blue backdrop. The filename identifies it as his official portrait (Wikipedia 220px thumbnail).
